title: 2026专硕英语 Unit 1 单词测试及校订

units.text:
原测试第1题
The patient reported ___ claudication while walking more than 200 meters, which was relieved after a short rest.

原文件答案：intermittent
校订后参考答案：intermittent
间歇的；断断续续的
intermittent claudication是间歇性跛行；此处用形容词修饰名词。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U1new.html

原测试第2题
Acute ___ of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is often triggered by bacterial or viral respiratory infections.

原文件答案：exacerbation
校订后参考答案：exacerbation
（病情）加重；恶化
acute exacerbation是急性加重；此处是作主语的名词单数，与is一致。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U1new.html

原测试第3题
It is essential for clinicians to ___ both the physical and psychological needs of patients with terminal illness.

原文件答案：address
校订后参考答案：address
处理；应对（问题或需要）
address needs/problems意为处理需要或问题；不译“地址”。to后用动词原形。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U1new.html

原测试第4题
Administering analgesics can effectively ___ postoperative pain and improve the patient's quality of recovery.

原文件答案：alleviate
校订后参考答案：alleviate
减轻；缓解
alleviate pain/symptoms表示减轻疼痛或症状；can后用原形，不等于彻底治愈。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U1new.html

原测试第5题
The committee reviewed the protocol and the ethical implications ___ before granting final approval.

原文件答案：thereof
校订后参考答案：thereof
其；关于前面提到的事物的
the ethical implications thereof指该方案的伦理影响，相当于of that protocol；不是表示“因此”的therefore。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U1new.html

原测试第6题
The attending physician decided to ___ the differential diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction after the ECG and troponin results were normal.
学习版修订题干：The physician decided not to ___ the possibility of acute myocardial infarction solely because the initial ECG and troponin results were normal.
原文件答案：dismiss
校订后参考答案：dismiss
不予考虑；摒除（某种可能或想法）
dismiss a possibility意为不再考虑一种可能；不能简单等同已经科学证实排除。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U1new.html

原测试第7题
Early recognition and prompt intervention can ___ a significant improvement in patient outcomes after stroke.

原文件答案：bring about
校订后参考答案：bring about
引起；导致
bring about an improvement表示带来改善；can后整组用原形。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U1new.html

原测试第8题
The hospital will ___ a new antimicrobial stewardship program next quarter to reduce inappropriate antibiotic use.

原文件答案：initiate
校订后参考答案：initiate
开始；发起；启动
initiate a program/study表示启动项目或研究；will后用原形。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U1new.html

warning: 原资料题型为词库填空，用于回忆词义与用法；本期期末词汇题为选择题。校订处保留原答案供对照。
